title: [Chapitre] VIII. Analysis situs (quatrième mouture) : notes manuscrites (26/06-04/07/1986).

errors: No mathematical error is visible. The general 'quotient by a |∘|-support' is explicitly conjectural ('on devine'). No proof is given that the quotient is well defined or compatible with the product •.

Calling (**) 'an isomorphism' is only correct after restricting to the image Figures(L)_{L0}. As a map out of all of Figures(L) it is a surjective retraction, not an isomorphism; the text implicitly means 'isomorphism onto / inverse of the embedding'.

ideas.what: Restriction of figures to a subset L0, described as a quotient that sets to zero all structures whose interior misses L0
ideas.modern_name: Quotient of a lattice/semiring by an ideal; restriction to a subspace (open-closed localisation analogue)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard lattice/Boolean algebra theory (Stone, Birkhoff); localisation à la Serre quotients in the abelian setting

ideas.what: General quotient by a |∘|-closed 'support' M of neglected elements, required to be a down-set for inclusion of interiors
ideas.modern_name: Quotient by an order ideal / support of a localisation; analogous to Serre subcategory or thick ideal
ideas.usually_credited_to: Lattice theory folklore; Serre quotients (Gabriel 1962) in abelian categories

ideas.what: Push-forward i_* along an inclusion as an embedding with image the figures located in L0, left inverse given by restriction
ideas.modern_name: Closed/open immersion push-forward fully faithful, i* i_* = id (recollement-type)
ideas.usually_credited_to: SGA4 / BBD recollement in the sheaf setting
ideas.where_published: Analogue of SGA4 formalism; this combinatorial 'figures' version is unpublished

missed.claim: Grothendieck sketches a general notion of quotient of the structure Fig(L) by any |∘|-closed family of neglected multistructures (a '|∘|-support'). It is never worked out here. It would give a localisation theory for his combinatorial 'figures', a tame-topology-like formalism.
missed.quote: On devine que de façon générale, un tel passage au quotient aura un sens précis ... une partie qui soit |∘|-fermée, ou un "|∘|"-support, dont les éléments seront négligés
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Of modest interest only. It fits the program of a combinatorial/o-minimal-style analysis situs with a six-operation-like calculus (see the projection formula on the next page). The idea itself is close to standard ideal quotients.

deep.surprise_reason: This is routine set-up of functoriality (restriction as quotient, push-forward as embedding) inside Grothendieck's unpublished 1986 'figures' formalism. The only forward-looking element is a brief conjectural remark on quotients by |∘|-closed supports, which is standard in spirit.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'pour toute A ⊂ 𝓛0' is better read as 'pour tout A ∈ 𝔏0', ending formula (2) of the previous page.
The final line 'est pas "pleinement fidèle" [?]' is most likely 'est [un] "plongement"'. The handwriting fits, and the next page says 'qui est elle-aussi un plongement'.
'Figures_{L0}(L0) ⥲ Figures(L)_{L0}' is the identification Figures(L0) ≅ Figures(L)_{L0}; the subscript on the first term appears struck/garbled.
'en tous [?] cas, dans un régime [?] M' is uncertain; it may read 'en termes de ..., dès qu'on néglige dans M une partie'. The sense is choosing a part of M whose elements are neglected (set to 0).
Page header '17' is probably the author's page number '47', consistent with the next page's '48'.
